entities.summary: Hendrik van Heuraet, also known as Henrici van Heuraet, was a Dutch mathematician. He is noted as one of the founders of the integral, and author of Epistola de Transmutatione Curvarum Linearum in Rectus [On the Transformation of Curves into Straight Lines] (1659).
